name: Sabcomeline
summary: Sabcomeline (Memric; SB-202,026) is a selective M1 receptor partial agonist that was under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease. It made it to phase III clinical trials before being discontinued due to poor results.

pharmacology.text: Sabcomeline (Memric; SB-202,026) is a selective M1 receptor partial agonist that was under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease. It is a non-selective agonist of all five muscarinic acetylcholine receptors with similar affinities.
